card.name: Words right before a dose amount
card.fires_on: Verbs or small words that come just before a quantity is named, such as prescribe, withdraw, or the prescribed/calculated dose, in preparation and dosing instructions. Also a few spots inside product names in dilution tables.

card.plain: It marks the spot in dosing instructions where the next words will state how much to give or draw up.
